name: Nokia

source.quote: From the consolidated income statement Net sales 19 889 19 220 21 138

description: Makes mobile, optical, IP and data center networking equipment and licenses telecom patents.
explain: Nokia sells network equipment to telecoms and cloud companies, including data center switches to Microsoft. Nvidia bought a $1 billion stake in 2025, and Nokia bought Infinera to sell more optical gear to hyperscalers.
